nonGoals: Arrowheads on open paths, an open/closed toggle UI, a stick-figure label band, native-type reconstruction on draw.io import, sequence lifeline export, and new geo kinds for ext or the 4/6/8-point stars (user-qa Q1-Q7 defaults).

constraints: Existing JSONL stays byte-identical: keyOrder additions are appended in lexicographic order, and closed:true is never written.
semantic.unknownField is a warning only, and unknown fields are preserved.
Run bun tests with BUN_OPTIONS=--jsx-runtime=classic and cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; self-authored neutral test data; no emojis; no tool attribution in commits.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Unknown semantic keys are a warning (code semantic.unknownField, path elements[i].semantic.<key>) rather than an error, so documents from newer builds still load and round-trip (design section 1).
keyOrder omissions are fixed in the registry (BPMN, database objects) rather than suppressed, so the warning stays meaningful for every type (design section 1, keyOrder audit).

The stick figure is a new GeoKind 'actor' instead of a change to 'person', so existing person shapes render unchanged; its box is the picking, port and connector region (geoOutlinePolygon returns null) (design section 2).
Open contours use an optional contour key closed:false; absent means closed, so existing JSONL is byte-identical and no schema bump is needed (design section 4).
CompoundPathGeometry gains parallel closed[] and openPath; path holds closed contours only, so fill and region consumers skip open contours without per-consumer branching (design section 4, DR-1).
PathWorldContour carries the closed flag through the edit pipeline so anchor drags and inspector edits never drop closed:false (design section 4, slc-06).
draw.io umlActor imports exactly as geo actor; geo actor exports as umlActor; uml.component, uml.interface and uml.port export natively because nodetto now has exact equivalents (design section 3).
intentionalTradeoffs: Stick figure label uses the existing centred geo label rule; no label band (user-qa Q1).
draw.io import keeps the freeform model; shape=component, requiredInterface and umlLifeline stay approximated on import (user-qa Q2).
Open contours are left out of the handoff CSS mask and Swift/Compose generated code (user-qa Q6).
No open/closed toggle in the path inspector; Add contour adds a closed contour (user-qa Q7).
draw.io style names shape=component and shape=requiredInterface are unverified; slc-05 records evidence and stops rather than inventing a mapping.
supportedEdgeCases: Nested unknown keys in keyOrder.children objects and array items (e.g. elements[0].semantic.columns[2].x, contours[0].x).
Own keys __proto__ and constructor are reported as unknown fields; unregistered types such as future.widget get no semantic.unknownField.
Open contour with exactly 2 points is valid; 1-point open contour is an error; 2-point closed contour keeps the existing closed-contour error.
Mixed [closed, open] contour paths: removing a contour preserves the remaining contour's closed flag; editing a closed contour writes no closed key.
Hit test on an open contour: a point on the stroke hits, a point between the open ends misses.
Flipped geo actor honours flip within the box.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Arrowheads or markers on open path ends (user-qa Q5).
Sequence participant and lifeline export to draw.io (user-qa Q3).
Native element reconstruction from draw.io import (user-qa Q2).
Geo kinds for ext and 4/6/8-point stars (user-qa Q4).
